title: Global Well-Posedness and Uniqueness of Gravity-Capillary Waves
exact_target: Establish global dynamics in the variational energy space and determine whether the corresponding solitary-wave minimizer is unique apart from translation.

status_qualification: These are the report's two missing hypotheses for the standard orbital-stability argument. Its energy space, constrained minimum, and water-wave parameter regime must be inherited from that contribution; the brief extract does not justify an assertion for all depths, surface tensions, or wave sizes.
